claims.text: If run exactly as specified, this design decides: Measured on one rented A100 SXM4 40 GB box, the median wall-clock of one hand-written single-thread CUDA Thomas solve and of one hand-written parallel cyclic reduction (PCR) solve of a diagonally dominant tridiagonal system of N equations, N in {2^10, 2^14, 2^18, 2^22, 2^24}, five seeds each, substituted into the card's own decision rule (if_lever iff median Thomas ms / median PCR ms at 2^24 >= 2 AND the speedup grows with N), resolve to if_lever; the card's measured-later numbers (max relative residual GUESS 1e-13; crossover N GUESS 1,024; speedup at 2^24 PROXY 28; need 2 h) are read against the measured values.. Endpoints: E1 anchor: max relative residual of Thomas and PCR at N = 2^10 and 2^14 (seed 0); pairwise relative difference in x against cuSPARSE gtsv2_nopivot and scipy solve_banded; difference between the two references at residuals <= 1e-10 (card res_tol) AND all pairwise differences < 1e-8 (card checks 1-4), refuted by any residual > 1e-10 or difference >= 1e-8: that solver's timing rows are labelled 'descriptive only; anchor failed' and E3 is not read for it; the card's own gate text applies ('Fix the kernels and re-run the anchor'); if the two references disagree, run_valid false everywhere; E2 card GUESS res_measured = 1e-13: measured max relative residual over the anchor levels and both hand-written solvers at holds if within [1e-14, 1e-12], refuted by outside: the card's GUESS is off by more than 10x (direction reported); E3 card decision: speedup(N) = median Thomas ms / median PCR ms; if_lever iff speedup(2^24) >= 2 AND speedup(2^24) > speedup(2^10) AND least-squares slope of ln(speedup) against log2(N) over the five levels > 0; label 'within noise' if the lower quartile of speedup(2^24) over seeds is <= 2 at if_lever as defined, refuted by speedup(2^24) < 2 OR not growing: if_not; the card's expected outcome is refuted; E4 card GUESS crossover_n = 1,024: smallest level at which the lower quartile over seeds of speedup(N) exceeds 1 at holds if the crossover is 2^10, refuted by crossover above 2^10 or none: the card's GUESS is refuted; E5 card PROXY speedup_at_nmax = 28: measured speedup(2^24) at within [9.3, 84] (3x either way), refuted by outside: the PROXY did not travel (direction and ratio reported); not a card prediction; E6 shape of PCR time (report only; tests the card's if_lever sentence 'grows like log2(N)'): g = (median PCR ms at 2^24 / median PCR ms at 2^22)^(1/2) at log-like if g <= 1.15; linear-like if g >= 1.7; between otherwise, refuted by none (descriptive); 'linear-like' means the sentence is wrong even if E3 holds; E7 CPU-floor reading (report only): E3's rule with median cpu_dgtsv ms in place of Thomas ms at if_lever or if_not under that baseline, with speedup_cpu(N) at every level, refuted by none (descriptive); the card's verdict is E3; E8 copies reading (report only; card check 6): batched Thomas ms / single Thomas ms at each level, and throughput factor K / that ratio at card claim holds if the ratio is within [0.9, 3] at every level, refuted by none (descriptive); ratio outside the band is reported as 'batched solve changes one system's latency'; E9 cuSPARSE reading (report only): median cuSPARSE ms at each level and its ratio to hand-written PCR at report, refuted by none (descriptive); E10 card cost line 'need 2 h': on-box wall-clock from the first anchor solve to the last sweep row, hours at holds if within [0.67, 6] h, refuted by below 0.67 h: the plan over-bought by more than 3x; above 6 h: the plan under-bought.
claims.evidence: {"hypothesis": "Measured on one rented A100 SXM4 40 GB box, the median wall-clock of one hand-written single-thread CUDA Thomas solve and of one hand-written parallel cyclic reduction (PCR) solve of a diagonally dominant tridiagonal system of N equations, N in {2^10, 2^14, 2^18, 2^22, 2^24}, five seeds each, substituted into the card's own decision rule (if_lever iff median Thomas ms / median PCR ms at 2^24 >= 2 AND the speedup grows with N), resolve to if_lever; the card's measured-later numbers (max relative residual GUESS 1e-13; crossover N GUESS 1,024; speedup at 2^24 PROXY 28; need 2 h) are read against the measured values.", "models": ["Thomas algorithm (forward elimination then back substitution), float64, hand-written CUDA kernel, ONE thread per system, recurrence kept in registers, each input read once per step; the card's baseline_sequential", "Parallel cyclic reduction (PCR), float64, hand-written CUDA kernel(s), one thread per equation per round, log2(N) rounds, ping-pong buffers; the card's method under test", "Batched Thomas: the same one-thread-per-system Thomas kernel over K independent systems at once, K = min(256, 2^28 / N) (GUESS: memory rule, the card leaves K unstated); the card's baseline_copies", "NVIDIA cuSPARSE gtsv2_nopivot (hybrid PCR + Thomas) called through ctypes on the system libcusparse (CUDA 12), buffer allocated once outside timing; the card's independent GPU reference", "scipy.linalg.solve_banded (LAPACK, CPU) as the independent CPU reference at the anchor levels; scipy.linalg.lapack.dgtsv (LAPACK tridiagonal, one core) as the CPU floor at every level (preinstalled scipy 1.8.0 on the image; the BLAS/LAPACK it links is read on the box and recorded)"], "data": "No downloaded data. Systems generated on the box by committed rule: a_i, c_i unit magnitude with seed-fixed random signs; b_i = 3 (dominance margin 1.0); d_i standard normal; float64; numpy default_rng(seed), seeds 0..4 (one per repeat), anchor uses seed 0. Per row: N, seed, first 8 values of a, b, c, d and sha256 of each array. ms per solve = block ms / R; cudaEvent before and after the block, cudaDeviceSynchronize after; median and interquartile range over seeds", "pcr_gpu: same protocol", "cusparse_gpu: same protocol, gtsv2_nopivot, buffer outside the block", "thomas_batched_gpu: K systems at once, same protocol; Order on the box: toolchain check and compile; anchor (E1, E2); timers; residual_sweep; thomas_gpu, pcr_gpu, cusparse_gpu, thomas_batched_gpu, cpu_dgtsv, each over all levels ascending; endpoints. A cost guard before each stage.", "layers_strengths": "not applicable (no model layers); sweep levels N = 1024, 16384, 262144, 4194304, 16777216 (the card's compute_axis levels)", "budget_usd": 8, "does_not_test": ["The full parallel-in-time Newton loop (the card's own limits); only the tridiagonal solve is timed", "Block-tridiagonal systems (card p3_block) and multi-GPU PCR (card p4_multi): optional phases, not run", "A multi-thread GPU Thomas (e.g. one warp per system) or any tuning beyond one thread per system with registers: the card fixes the baseline as one thread per system; how wrong: a cooperative sequential kernel could cut the baseline's time several-fold and shrink every speedup", "Non-dominant or ill-conditioned matrices, float32, multiple right-hand sides (card held_fixed)", "The block rule R (GUESS): per-solve times for sub-millisecond solves include launch gaps; how wrong: at N = 2^10 PCR's 10 rounds are 10 launches, so its 'solve time' is mostly launch latency, inflating Thomas's apparent advantage at small N by up to about 2x", "K for the batched arm (GUESS: 256 capped by 2^28 total equations): a different K changes the throughput factor, not the latency ratio", "Thresholds 1.15 and 1.7 for E6 (GUESS): a log-like PCR from 2^22 to 2^24 would grow by 24/22 = 1.09 in rounds, hence 1.045 per doubling; 1.7 per doubling is within 15% of linear", "Which BLAS/LAPACK scipy 1.8.0 links on the image (read on the box, recorded, not controlled)", "Whether nvcc is on the image (MEMORY: Lambda Stack ships the CUDA toolkit); if absent the run halts, RUN_VALID false, no install"]}
confounds: decidability by construction: is any endpoint outcome forced, unable to occur, or deciding a different question than the seed asks
coordinates and scale: could the chosen layers, strengths, or units make every cell degenerate or null regardless of the hypothesis

instruments.asserts: E1 anchor: max relative residual of Thomas and PCR at N = 2^10 and 2^14 (seed 0); pairwise relative difference in x against cuSPARSE gtsv2_nopivot and scipy solve_banded; difference between the two references
E2 card GUESS res_measured = 1e-13: measured max relative residual over the anchor levels and both hand-written solvers

E3 card decision: speedup(N) = median Thomas ms / median PCR ms; if_lever iff speedup(2^24) >= 2 AND speedup(2^24) > speedup(2^10) AND least-squares slope of ln(speedup) against log2(N) over the five levels > 0; label 'within noise' if the lower quartile of speedup(2^24) over seeds is <= 2
E4 card GUESS crossover_n = 1,024: smallest level at which the lower quartile over seeds of speedup(N) exceeds 1
E5 card PROXY speedup_at_nmax = 28: measured speedup(2^24)
E6 shape of PCR time (report only; tests the card's if_lever sentence 'grows like log2(N)'): g = (median PCR ms at 2^24 / median PCR ms at 2^22)^(1/2)
E7 CPU-floor reading (report only): E3's rule with median cpu_dgtsv ms in place of Thomas ms
E8 copies reading (report only; card check 6): batched Thomas ms / single Thomas ms at each level, and throughput factor K / that ratio
E9 cuSPARSE reading (report only): median cuSPARSE ms at each level and its ratio to hand-written PCR
E10 card cost line 'need 2 h': on-box wall-clock from the first anchor solve to the last sweep row, hours
